findings.affected_path_or_operation: Inference release and provider stop recovery
findings.problem: Release bindings require an externally verified current callback. Composed Data has no verified provider-stop authority.
findings.recommendation: Connect current signed release custody and generation-bound stop evidence to the separate deployed roles.
findings.verification: Exercise exact bundle rejection, in-flight disable and confirmed slot recovery in the target role topology.

remaining_risks: Complete isolated SPIRE and Envoy topology for Core, Data, Runtime, Inference and the host bridge, credential rotation, and manual continuity with live disablement.
Compose authenticated generation-bound provider stop authority and measure durable timeout, cancellation, restart, recovery and workload-scale latency in the deployed topology.
Verify an immutable evaluated release binding, signer provenance and evaluator digest/epoch/boot acknowledgment. Preserve independent exact-bundle human approval for serving activation.
Keep other actor task profiles disabled pending separate evidence. Human implementation usability review remains deferred until after IMP-10.
